author: Epic Games
description:
Greed is a powerful motivator… and Styx has plenty of it!  

Styx: Blades of Greed is now available on Epic Games Store. https://epic.gm/styx-greed
Everyone’s favorite goblin assassin is back for his most ambitious adventure. Infiltrate big places, outsmart deadly enemies, and master brutal stealth abilities in a dark fantasy world where power is currency.  

This time, it’s bigger. More vertical. More dangerous. And far more rewarding. Sharpen your blades, embrace the shadows, and steal what was never meant to be yours.
title: Styx: Blades of Greed | Launch Trailer | Available Now

author: Epic Games
description:
Make your mark. Earn the Number.  
Discover a re-imagined origin story as James Bond enters the 00 Programme as a promising young recruit. Despite his occasional recklessness, Bond's intuition, charm, and skill will push him to Earn The Number within His Majesty's Secret Service.
